title: The best guide we have had in all our years of extensive travel
text: We had the great luck of having Salvafore guide us for the Seville Small Group Tour: Alcazar, Cathedral & Giralda. He was absolutely superb. His knowledge was mind-boggling, and added to his great sense of humor, he was by the far the best guide we have ever had on our extensive travels over the years. I wish we could take him everywhere with us!  Thank you Salvatore so much for helping us understand and truly appreciate the hundreds of years of Spanish history encapsulated in Seville.
author: AliisaP8
